OnPlay.issue: Closed 2026-07-29 (round 7): `cards.pool.take_random` is `IEnumerableExtensions.TakeRandom` (IEnumerableExtensions.cs:17-20) -- `collection.ToList().UnstableShuffle(rng).Take(count)` -- and it encodes all three things `random.sample` got wrong: a FULL Fisher-Yates whatever `count` is (so the stream lands where the game's does), over a COPY (`.ToList()`), with no clamp on `count` (`Take(n)` on a shorter sequence yields the whole thing). Distraction.cs:25-27 names `Rng.CombatCardGeneration`, so the site calls `get_distinct_for_combat_parity(<rng>.card_gen, ...)` -- the ready-made port of `CardFactory.GetDistinctForCombat`, whose body IS shuffle-then-take over `FilterForCombat`'s id list. The `is_parity` branch is gone rather than added to: the ALGORITHM was wrong in legacy mode too, and 'original means game source' says fix the engine rather than preserve the old sim sequence.  Pinned by test/test_take_random_streams.py, which gives every named accessor its own Random and asserts the site advanced the one its C# names and did NOT touch the shared `combat._rng`.  NOT CLOSED: nothing at this site.  The text it replaced read: The shape is right -- generate 1 distinct SKILL from the character pool, make it free this turn, add it to hand, in that order. WRONG RNG STREAM: `CardFactory.GetDistinctForCombat(..., 1, Owner.RunState.Rng.CombatCardGeneration)` (Distraction.cs:25-27) names the CombatCardGeneration stream; the sim calls `random_pool_cards(ctx.combat._rng, 1, _CT.SKILL, distinct=True)` (trash_heap_cards.py:113) on the unseeded shared `random.Random`, even though `ctx.combat.combat_rng.card_gen` maps to `combat_card_generation` (combat_rng.py:20,52), and `rng.sample` (pool.py:158) is a different draw sequence from GetDistinctForCombat's. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/anointed, card/beat_down and card/discovery (rule 3). LIVE -- Distraction is a ported Event Skill from the Trash Heap and the parity stream is wired. REGRESSION TEST: `test/test_rng_tripwire.py:33` (`test_no_wrong_stream_draws_in_random_run`, 20 seeded full runs) is the standing gate for this whole family. It wraps `RunState.rng` and asserts ZERO in-combat draws on it; `CombatState` receives that same object as `self._rng` (run.py:1146-1148, combat.py:88), so a `ctx.combat._rng` draw taken from inside a card's `on_play` is recorded and fails the gate -- verified by playing this family's shape under a `Tripwire` and getting a hit at the `card.on_play` frame (combat.py:490). The gate is green today, so these 20 seeds never reach this card's draw; routing the site to the named `combat_rng` accessor is verified by keeping it green.
